Apply for the 2026 community grant

The community grant supports small projects run by residents of Elm Valley: repairs to shared spaces, after-school activities, and neighbourhood events. Grants range from £500 to £5,000 and are paid in full once the project is approved.

Applications close on June 30, 2026 at 5 pm. Late applications are not considered, and incomplete forms are returned once for correction.

Before you start, have a short project description, a budget and the contact details of a second committee member to hand. You can save nothing halfway, so allow fifteen minutes.

Decisions are sent by email within four weeks of the closing date. Successful applicants are invited to a short welcome meeting in July.
